name: MembershipRenewalManager
tagline: Levels, renewals, grace, win-back and notices – the whole membership renewal cycle in one app.
description: A complete membership renewal app for nonprofits, museums, societies and associations in one PCF control: membership levels with prices and benefits, a renewal pipeline (due in 60 / 30 days, grace, lapsed win-back, renewed), renewals with payment and discount rules, backdated grace renewals and rejoins, pro-rated upgrades and scheduled downgrades, auto-renew, a notice schedule with merged renewal letters, and retention, dues and expected-revenue KPIs.
features: Renewal window, grace period and lapse
Backdated renewal in grace, rejoin after lapse
Payment validation with discount / concession reasons
Notice schedule (60/30/0/-14 days) with merged letters and NoticeText output
Gift memberships addressed to the giver
Retention rate, auto-renew rate, dues this month / YTD, expected renewal revenue
controlType: standard (2 controls: MembershipRenewalManager data-set, MembershipRenewalManagerPortal field)
